notes: Compatible patch release carrying the accepted issue #333 owner-only enrollment-policy transaction. Only the current active platform owner can strictly read, preview, or apply policy; preview returns a deterministic revision bound to the validated canonical policy and verified provider-backed audit head/count, and apply compares that exact revision inside the same provider transaction before proposal, operational logging, policy mutation, or audit append. A successful apply atomically commits the exact policy plus a bounded hash-linked opaque-actor change record and returns the exact prior policy, consumed revision, and new revision for explicit application rollback. The provider-neutral strict security-document seam treats only true absence as the reviewed fallback; malformed schema-owned bytes, duplicate JSON keys, access failures, audit mismatch, stale or ABA revision, and capacity failure preserve exact provider state without fallback, backup, normalization, read-side write, or mutation. Existing login, public signup and invitation enforcement envelopes, bounded operational decision logging, legacy non-mapping or unowned-schema environment fallback, and frozen /api/v1 remain unchanged. The release invokes no live policy change and adds no readiness, UI, OAuth/provider enablement, provider network, public exposure, credential, DNS, billing, mail, migration, grant, or issue-closure authority. It retains the MySQL schema-two/schema-three rollback bridge with apply_policy held, production at exact schema two, and exact immutable v0.9.5.41 as the application-only predecessor; database rollback is prohibited. Schema-three activation, the MySQL composite transaction, receipt-table grant and drift hardening, routes, games, Slots adoption, ledger behavior, provider scaling, and all-provider atomicity remain separately governed. Issues #333, #430, and #471 remain open.
